messages:
incident-bot: ALARM: P1 - Elevated API TLS handshake failures and 5xx across EU edge POPs. Paging on-call.
Alex O (oncall): I'm on it. Observability shows spike at 08:12UTC, 50% of requests failing with TLS handshake errors (+SNI alerts) from CF EU POPs.
Maria L (eng-runtime): seeing the same - traces show connection reset before TLS handshake. Aggregated app logs: ``"tls: handshake failure"`` 5xx from nginx proxy.
Jamal R (netops): dig +trace for api.redwood.example.com -> intermittently returns SERVFAIL from some upstream resolvers, others fine. Traceroute from us-east to EU edge shows path flapping.
Alex O (oncall): Cloudflare-status-bot: any incidents?
cloudflare-status-bot: [automated] Cloudflare reports an issue with 'Edge TLS termination' in EU region, ticket 9801223 opened.
Priya S (support): Customer reports incoming: multiple teams seeing 502/524s. We should start impact assessment: which orgs in EU are affected?
Dana C (product): Pulling list from billing - ~12 active dedicated customers in EU with SLA. Flagging account ops and CSM.
Maria L (eng-runtime): Quick mitigations: 1) Force fallback to direct origin (bypass CF) for critical routes via traffic router, 2) Increase TLS handshake timeout on edge LB, 3) Roll back last CF edge config (was a cert reload/pinned SNI change at 08:05UTC).
Alex O (oncall): Prioritize 1 & 3. Jamal, can you open temporary DNS override (low TTL) -> origin IPs for api-reachable-cf-bypass.redwood.internal and update router? I'll coordinate with CF support and ask for roll back.
Jamal R (netops): I'll push DNS override to our authoritative with 30s TTL and update traffic router. Pushing now.
Alex O (oncall): Running quick checks: ``curl -v --resolve api.redwood.com:443:203.0.113.17 https://api.redwood.com/health`` shows successful 200 when resolving to origin IP; failing when routed via CF.
Maria L (eng-runtime): Here's openssl output when CF path fails:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.com:443 -servername api.redwood.com
CONNECTED(00000003)
139832...:error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure
---
no peer certificate available
```
Alex O (oncall): Noted. I filed a new ticket with CF support 9801223 -> escalated to network ops. They confirmed an edge config deployment at 08:04 that is correlated.
Priya S (support): Notifying impacted customers: short message drafted - ETA unknown, we're mitigating, will follow up every 15m. Approving send.
Dana C (product): Escalate billing/ops if ETA > 60m. CSMs alerted.
cloudflare-status-bot: Update: 'Mitigation in progress - rollback of edge config initiated'.
Alex O (oncall): After DNS override and traffic-router update, error rate dropped from 48% -> 6% in 4m. Continuing monitoring.
Maria L (eng-runtime): Keep traces on. I'll open a canary to verify latency & correctness vs prod traffic. Also capturing packet logs to share with CF.
Jamal R (netops): Rolling back DNS override at 08:35UTC after CF confirmed rollback completed. Switching back gradually.
Alex O (oncall): Post-rollback metrics look stable: handshake failure <1%, overall errors normal. Closing page but leaving ticket open for postmortem.
Priya S (support): Sending update to customers: mitigated, rollback confirmed, follow-up postmortem to be shared.
Dana C (product): Please add action items: - tighten CF deploy gating for edge TLS changes, - add automatic fallback to origin for TLS failures, - run dry-run of DNS override path quarterly.
Maria L (eng-runtime): I'll own the postmortem. Collecting traces/logs + CF incident timeline. Tagging infra team.
Alex O (oncall): Thanks team. Handoff to next oncall @jamal in 30m. I'll update incident channel when PM for postmortem is ready. :white_check_mark:
